correctness.rationale: Every radius-one ball in the cyclic Kendall graph on \(S_5\) is constructed directly and has size \(6\). Exhaustive exact-cover search over all \(120\) balls yields exactly six covers of size \(20\). Independent group computation verifies that \(\operatorname{AGL}(1,5)\) is a subgroup of order \(20\), has six left cosets, and that those cosets equal the six exact covers. Direct coverage, orbit, and stabilizer checks reproduce the stated claim. No infinite conclusion is drawn.

value.rationale: The source that introduced the cyclic Kendall construction explicitly asks whether further perfect codes exist. The new result gives the complete degree-five answer and a natural group-theoretic rigidity statement: all solutions are exactly the six affine-group cosets. This is a motivated equality classification, not a routine parameter increment or arbitrary enumeration.
